# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal has a striking appearance with a full, eye-catching shape, radiant skin, and big, vivid blue eyes. She wears a lengthy blonde plait that she styles up when in town, but lets down upon returning home. At Regent's Academy, she was recognized as the most beautiful girl.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Opal possesses a sunny and pleasant disposition, indulging in laughter and enjoying life. She is sentimental and heavily preoccupied with male attention, constantly talking about suitors, boyfriends, and romantic proposals. In moments of panic or severe stress, she is prone to fits of hysterics.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c28 P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

- sentimental  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>

- tree climbing  <sub>[v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- to get a boyfriend upon turning fifteen  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>
- to keep suitors dangling and drive them wild once reaching adulthood  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- to have dozens of suitors and enjoy a gay time before settling down  <sub>[v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>
- to teach for two years following qualification and then marry  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

As a schoolgirl at Brierley school, Opal shared treats with Nell Harcourt and engaged in games with her classmates, though she was prone to weeping or falling into hysterics during emotional moments or mishaps. She successfully climbed a large willow tree on a dare despite her terror of caterpillars. She later participated in a girls' writing club where she contributed romantic stories. While studying alongside her friends at Regent's Academy, she was considered the most beautiful girl in attendance and frequently walked home accompanied by Hugh Carrow. After qualifying to teach, she secured a position at the Delford school. During her time teaching at Delford, she received a romantic proposal from Nelson Atkins; however, after discovering he had copied his speech verbatim from an etiquette book, she sent him a scathing rejection.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c19 P59](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0059), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)_

## Quotes

> Neither do I. Floating downward does not bother me when two or three of us are occupying the flat and we are able to sit upright. During those times, it is enjoyable.
